 **Prospecta** 
 an exhilarating place to work, bringing a rich tapestry of perspectives and ideas.
 



  





**Job Description of Senior Quality Assurance Engineer**

 **quality, reliability, and performance**

 **designing and executing testing strategies**

 Evaluate and interpret trends in defect occurrences to guide quality improvement efforts.
* **Conduct Performance Testing:** 
 Perform load, stress, and spike testing to assess the software’s behavior under various conditions.

* **Engage with Cross\-Functional Teams:** 
 Work with cross\-functional teams to resolve quality issues and ensure prompt and effective solutions.
* **Drive Quality Process Improvements:** 
 Contribute to initiatives aimed at enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of the quality assurance processes.
* **Stay Current on Industry Practices:** 
 Keep informed about the latest best practices and trends in software testing.
* **Communicate Progress Effectively:** 
 Maintain clear communication with team members and project stakeholders regarding testing progress, issues, and potential risks.
* **Participate in Team Meetings:** 
 Take part in team meetings to provide insights, collaborate on project objectives, and align on goals.



  





**Must\-Have Skills:** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication, Mechatronics, or related fields. Advanced degrees or relevant certifications, such as ISTQB, are plus.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as Java.
* Experience with test automation tools and frameworks, including Selenium, TestNG, and JUnit.
* Competency in database querying using SQL and data validation techniques.
* Familiarity with version control systems like Git and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes.
* Understanding of project management and issue tracking tools, such as JIRA.
* Knowledge of Master Data Management (MDM) concepts and data governance principles.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Exceptional attention to detail with a dedication to delivering high\-quality outcomes.

**Growth Path:** 




  





**At Prospecta** 
 , your career journey is one of growth and opportunity. Here, depending on your career journey you can either kickstart your career or accelerate your professional development in a dynamic environment. Your success is our priority, and as you demonstrate your abilities and achieve results, you'll have the chance to advance into the leadership role such as Regional Delivery Manager or in other cross functional areas. We're committed to helping you elevate your experience and skillsets, providing you with the tools, support, and opportunities to reach new heights in your career.

title: Lead - MBD Validation (EV Controls)
description:
**Role:** 
 Lead \- MBD Validation (EV Controls)
 



  





 Location: Mohan Estate, Delhi
 



  





 Technical Skills Required:
 



  





 Responsibilities
 


* About the role
* We design our vehicle controllers in\-house, so no Tier\-1 supplier validates the software for us. That makes validation our own quality gate between a Simulink model and a vehicle in a customer's fleet.
* You will build and run that gate: the test strategy, the MIL/SIL/PIL/HIL infrastructure, the automation, and the release sign\-off. Our vehicles run 150–250 km a day in commercial duty, so a field fault means lost revenue for a fleet operator, not just a warranty claim.
* Key responsibilities
* **Validation strategy and process**
* • Define the V\-model validation strategy for each controller: what is proven at MIL, SIL, PIL, HIL and vehicle level, and what exit criteria each stage needs.
* • Derive test cases from system and software requirements, with bidirectional traceability (requirements ↔ model ↔ test ↔ result).
* • Set and enforce model quality gates: MAAB/JMAAB modelling guidelines, Model Advisor checks, and structural coverage targets (decision, condition, MC/DC as needed).
* • Own software release sign\-off: no controller build ships to production or fleet without a validation report from your team.
* **Model and code\-level testing**
* • Run unit and integration testing on Simulink/Stateflow models using Simulink Test, Test Manager and harnesses.
* • Run back\-to\-back (MIL vs SIL/PIL) equivalence testing on auto\-generated Embedded Coder / TargetLink code.
* • Drive static analysis and run\-time error checks on generated and handwritten C (Polyspace or equivalent, MISRA C).
* • Build and maintain plant models (motor, inverter, battery, charger, vehicle dynamics) fit for closed\-loop testing.
* **HIL and test infrastructure**
* • Own the HIL benches (dSPACE SCALEXIO or equivalent): architecture, I/O and CAN configuration, fault\-injection, and commissioning of new rigs.
* • Build test automation (Python, AutomationDesk / ECU\-TEST or equivalent) with nightly regression runs integrated into CI (Jenkins/GitLab).
* • Cover fault\-injection and edge cases the vehicle can't safely reproduce: sensor failures, CAN loss, thermal derating, over/under\-voltage, contactor faults.
* **Vehicle and field validation**
* • Plan and support vehicle\-level validation with the T\&V team, using CAN logs (CANoe/CANalyzer) to close the loop between bench and road.
* • Triage field and fleet issues back to root cause in model or code, and add a regression test for every escaped defect.
* **Team and cross\-functional leadership**
* • Hire, lead and mentor a team of 4–6 validation engineers.
* • Work with controls, embedded, electrical, charging and service teams, plus suppliers for sensors, cells and chargers.
* • Support functional safety (ISO 26262\) and cybersecurity (ISO/SAE 21434\) work products for validation, and prepare for ASPICE\-style process audits.
* Must\-have qualifications
* • B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation or Mechanical Engineering; M.Tech in automotive electronics or controls preferred.
* • 8–12 years in automotive controls, with at least 5 years hands\-on in MBD testing and validation.
* • Deep MATLAB/Simulink/Stateflow skills, including Simulink Test and Embedded Coder or TargetLink generated code.
* • Proven MIL and unit testing of production controller models, with coverage and traceability reporting.
* • Hands\-on HIL experience on dSPACE, NI or Vector platforms, including fault\-injection testing.
* • Working knowledge of at least two EV controllers (VCU, MCU, BMS or charger) and how they interact over CAN.
* • CAN tools fluency: CANoe/CANalyzer, DBC management, log\-based debugging.
* • Test scripting in Python for automation and log analysis.
* • Has taken at least one EV controller software release from model to production vehicle.
* Good\-to\-have qualifications
* • Set up or commissioned an EV controls lab or HIL bench from scratch.
* • ISO 26262 functional safety exposure (ASIL decomposition, safety\-case evidence from testing).
* • ISO/SAE 21434 cybersecurity awareness or certification.
* • ASPICE SWE.4–SWE.6 process experience or audit participation.
* • CI/CD for model\-based workflows (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Simulink Project, Git/SVN).
* • Static analysis with Polyspace and MISRA C compliance.
* • Battery algorithms (SOC/SOH estimation) or DC fast\-charging protocols (Bharat DC\-001, CCS2, GB/T).
* • Commercial 3W or 4W EV background, where duty cycles and fleet uptime drive requirements.

description:

**If we receive a high volume of applications, we may close this vacancy earlier than the advertised deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.**
**About The Job**
 The Product Engineer designs and builds the digital products that farmers, field teams, programme partners, and BCI teams rely on to collect data and carry out field activities. The role combines product judgement, design sensibility, and hands\-on software engineering to turn field and programme requirements into simple, reliable products in production. The Product Engineer is key strengthening the quality and usability of Better Cotton's field\-facing digital tools and, in turn, the efficiency of field operations across our programme geographies.
   

  

****The Challenge****
 Looking ahead to 2030, we are targeting reducing GHG emissions from cotton production by half, big cuts in synthetic pesticide use, improve soil health across our network, improve farm income and support women’s empowerment among farmers and farm workers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 In this role, you will be responsible for :
   

  

* Review and stress\-test requirements from subject\-matter experts and programme teams, identifying unclear assumptions and unnecessary complexity before build begins.
* Partner with the Product Designer to shape simple, effective user flows for mobile, offline, and multilingual field use.
* Translate agreed solutions into clear, prioritised, testable delivery increments, and build high\-quality features across frontend, backend, and data layers.
* Use AI coding agents throughout prototyping, development, testing, and debugging to accelerate delivery without compromising quality, security, or maintainability.
* Write automated tests and instrument products to track adoption, performance, and reliability in real\-world field conditions.
* Release features safely, support their rollout, and iterate based on field feedback and product usage data.
* Work collaboratively with the line manager to set clear, outcome\-based objectives that align with function\-wide and organisational goals.
* Take ownership of agreed objectives, ensuring alignment with team priorities and performance expectations.


**Experience**
 the following skills, knowledge, and experience:
   

  

**Essential**
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* 5\+ years of relevant experience, with a strong track record of personally building, shipping, and improving production digital products that users value and rely on; evidence of judgement, scope, and delivery matters more than tenure.
* Experience taking products from prototype through production, rollout, and continuous improvement.
* Strong product and interaction\-design judgement, gained working closely with designers and subject\-matter experts.
* Experience using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as a core part of development, testing, debugging, and code review.
* Experience testing, deploying, monitoring, and supporting production applications.
* Experience with agriculture, field operations, offline products, multilingual interfaces, geospatial workflows, or products for users with varying digital literacy is valuable.
* Experience building modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and related frontend technologies.
* Experience developing backend services, APIs, and databases using Python (or a comparable language), SQL, and cloud\-based infrastructure.
* Fluency in written and spoken English is essential.


**Desirable**
* Proficiency in Hindi, Urdu, Swahili, or other relevant languages would be advantageous.


**What We Offer**
* Hybrid working opportunity, with the office days based in Delhi.
* The opportunity to work from anywhere in the world for up to one month per year
* Flexible working, with core hours from 10 am to 4 pm local time
* Continuous learning and development
* Pension scheme
* A generous annual leave package, including paid holiday, public holidays, additional paid days off during the festive season, study and exam days, and extra discretionary leave for life events such as family weddings or moving home
* Enhanced parental benefits
* The opportunity to make your mark and make a difference.


****Working arrangements****
 The position is full\-time (40 hours per week) and will be based in Delhi. Better Cotton Initiative offers flexible working, with core hours being 10 am – 4 pm. The position may require limited international travel.
   

  

****Apply now****
 Send us your CV (2 pages maximum) and a brief cover letter (1\-page maximum) by or before
 ****08\.10\.2026****
 via the application link.
   

  

 In your cover letter, please include an explanation of why your experience is specifically relevant to this role at Better Cotton Initiative. We want to see your personal style – what makes you tick and why you think your next opportunity is here with us.
   

  

 Better Cotton Initiative does not use artificial intelligence or in its hiring process. Every application is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team and relevant hiring managers to ensure a fair and human\-led assessment experience.
   

  

****Our hiring process****
**Initial Screening**
 Applicant screening is a crucial step in our recruitment process. This stage may involve a brief phone interview or video call to evaluate your suitability for the position. During this screening, we review resumes and cover letters, and may conduct initial background checks to narrow down the pool of applicant. Internal candidates are encouraged to inform their line manager about their application to promote transparency and help facilitate a smooth transition if selected.
   

  

**Interviews**
 If you successfully pass the initial screening, you will be invited for interviews. The interview process at Better Cotton Initiative may include one or more rounds of interviews with various stakeholders, such as the hiring manager, team members, and potentially senior management. As an internal candidate, you may have discussions regarding your current responsibilities and how they will transition to the new position.
   

  

**Assessment And Testing**
 Depending on the role, you might be required to complete assessments, technical tests, or skills evaluations to gauge your competency and suitability for the position. Internal candidates may have the option to demonstrate their existing skills through current job performance or past project outcomes.
   

  

**Reference Checks**
 Once you progress further in the process, reference checks are conducted to validate your work history, skills, and qualifications, and for some roles, your education and criminal history. Internal candidates may be asked for references from current or previous supervisors within Better Cotton Initiative to provide insights into their performance and capabilities.
   

  

**Offer Stage**
 After completing interviews, assessments, and reference checks, the hiring team evaluates your performance and fit for the role. If you are selected and your references are relevant and satisfactory, you will receive a formal job offer letter outlining the terms of employment, compensation, benefits, and any other relevant details. For internal candidates, the offer process may include a discussion about how your transition to the new role will be managed and any support needed for a smooth handover.

We exist to catalyse the cotton farming community with partners, governments and others to continuously drive positive impact by setting standards and facilitating the supply and demand of more sustainable cotton from farm to brand. In just 15 years we have aligned more than a fifth of the world’s cotton with our standard and helped farmers and farming communities thrive. Join us in building a better, more sustainable future for cotton worldwide.

* Trustworthy (including honest, transparent, credible)
* As having Integrity (including responsible, authentic)
* Positive (including problem\-solving, pragmatic)
* Engaging (including adaptable, inclusive, holistic)
* Daring (including courageous, innovative, game\-changing)

title: Senior Software QA Engineer
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
   

  

 If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
   

  

**Skills And Competencies**
* 5\+ years of experience in software quality engineering with hands\-on expertise testing Java\-based backend services and RESTful application programming interfaces
* Proficiency with test automation frameworks such as Selenium, TestNG, JUnit, RestAssured, or Cucumber for user interface and application programming interface testing
* Strong understanding of relational databases including PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server to perform data validation and verify data integrity across test scenarios
* Hands\-on experience testing Anthropic Claude integrated features, including large language model output validation, semantic evaluation techniques, hallucination detection, and streaming application programming interface behavior
* Familiarity with Model Context Protocol and agentic artificial intelligence testing patterns, including tool\-use accuracy, context management, and deterministic versus non\-deterministic output validation
* Experience with artificial intelligence security testing, including prompt injection testing, jailbreak validation, sensitive data leakage checks, and application reliability and performance assessments
* Strong understanding of software design principles and microservices architectures, with the ability to develop effective test strategies and identify system\-level edge cases
* Deep expertise in artificial intelligence, with a track record of implementing advanced AI solutions to drive strategic transformation and operational efficiency. Strong experience using AI tools to lead innovation initiatives. Demonstrated leadership in managing AI\-related risks, ensuring ethical governance, and fostering a culture of responsible AI adoption across the organization.


**Education**
* Bachelor or Master of Science in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field


**Responsibilities**
 Lead quality engineering and artificial intelligence testing initiatives to ensure reliable, scalable, and secure software solutions across cloud\-based platforms.
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites for Java\-based backend services and RESTful application programming interfaces to ensure high software quality across releases
* Own the test strategy for Anthropic Claude integrated features, including large language model output validation, regression baselines, tool\-call accuracy verification, context management validation, and end\-to\-end integration coverage
* Build and maintain continuous integration integrated evaluation frameworks for non\-deterministic artificial intelligence outputs, including rubric\-based scoring, automated prompt regression suites, and behavioral drift detection
* Collaborate with product owners, software engineers, and machine learning engineers to define testable requirements, review acceptance criteria, and ensure high\-quality delivery across agile releases
* Perform database validation testing against PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server environments to verify data integrity, transformation logic, and backend workflow accuracy
* Conduct artificial intelligence specific security testing, including prompt injection, adversarial input validation, jailbreak testing, and sensitive data leakage assessments aligned with Moody’s governance standards
* Define and enforce synthetic or masked test data standards for artificial intelligence feature testing to ensure appropriate handling of confidential and regulated information
* Monitor and report quality, performance, and artificial intelligence observability metrics including token consumption, streaming latency, tool\-call success rates, model error rates, and reliability indicators
* Integrate automated testing into continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, ensuring quality gates and deployment controls are effective and actionable

**The Role** 
 : Product Operations Specialist.
   

  

**The Team:** 
 The Corporate Actions Data Operations team is responsible for corporate actions validation operations, customer support and new client onboarding, vendor management, quality control, and strategic support for new product initiatives. The Corporate Actions Validation Data Operations team monitors domestic and international corporate actions announcements from inception, applies a stringent cleansing and enrichment process, and produces validated composite corporate actions records for clients.
   

  

**The Impact:** 
 This role ensures corporate actions are accurately captured, researched, validated, and published so clients can confidently notify their end\-investors, make investment decisions, and allocate entitlements resulting from events. Your validation decisions and guidance can have significant monetary and risk implications for downstream clients, particularly when event terms, deadlines, and elections must be interpreted precisely. By improving data quality and responsiveness, you directly strengthen client trust, service performance, and overall product reliability.
   

  

* High\-impact, market\-critical work where your research and judgment directly reduce client risk and operational breaks.
* Deep domain exposure to domestic and international corporate actions, market practices, and event nuances.
* Client\-facing responsibility that builds strong stakeholder management skills and credibility as a subject matter expert.
* Opportunities to drive change through process improvements, quality initiatives, training delivery, and UAT/special projects.


**Responsibilities**
* Validate and publish corporate actions composite records by reviewing announcements and completing required event terms, key dates, options, and deadlines.
* Conduct in\-depth research using issuer documentation (e.g., prospectuses/information circulars), exchanges/bulletins, web sources, and vendor feeds to reconcile discrepancies and confirm accuracy.
* Liaise with external parties (agents, custodians, banks, vendors, exchange officials, transfer/paying agents) to obtain and confirm event specifics, including reconciliation to issuer “golden copy.”
* Manage exceptions and risk by reviewing daily exception reports, investigating breaks, escalating unresolved discrepancies, and ensuring timely resolution aligned to SLAs.
* Provide client support via email/phone by explaining decisions, citing research, guiding interpretation, and delivering system/service enablement where needed.

**Key Qualifications**

* High attention to detail and a strong quality mindset; able to spot inconsistencies and prevent downstream impact.
* Sound judgment and intellectual curiosity—comfortable working through ambiguous, unique scenarios to reach defensible conclusions.

title: SAP B1 Techno Functional Consultant

 Our client is a Leather and Fur manufacturer and exporter based out of Delhi and Gurgaon. The
 



 company is an unlisted Indian private company that operates a contemporary clothing brand and
 



 serves as a strategic partner for global brands like Nike and Converse in India. The company acts as a
 



 strategic partner to global brands in India. Operating in major Indian cities and also manage the
 



 brands franchise for Pan India operations. The company also produces trendy and contemporary
 



 apparels and fashion accessories in India.
 



  





**Location \& work** 
 – Gurgaon
 



**Employment Type** 
 \- Full Time
 



**Profile** 
 – SAP B1 Techno Functional Consultant
 



**Preferred experience** 
 – 4\-6 Years
 



  





**The Role:** 




 We are looking for a techno\-functional SAP Business One (SAP B1\) Consultant to join our team. The
 



 role will work with IT and business stakeholders to support SAP B1 implementation, customization,
 



 integrations, process automation and ongoing system optimization. The ideal candidate will have
 



 strong expertise in SAP B1 modules, SQL, SAP HANA, Crystal Reports, integrations and business
 



 analysis.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




 1\. SAP B1 Implementation \& Support
 



  Lead and support SAP Business One implementation, configuration, testing, deployment and
 



 post\-go\-live activities.
 



  Provide ongoing functional and technical support for SAP B1\.
 



  Analyze business processes, identify gaps and recommend SAP B1 solutions.
 



  Manage hypercare and post\-production support.
 



  Drive system enhancements, optimization and continuous improvements.
 



 2\. Functional \& Technical Expertise
 



  Demonstrate strong knowledge of SAP B1 modules including:
 



 o Financials
 



 o Sales
 



 o Purchasing
 



 o Inventory
 



 o Warehouse Management
 



 o Production
 



 o Integrations
 



  Work extensively with SAP HANA, SQL and Crystal Reports.
 



  Develop queries and support dashboards, reports and business insights.
 



  Ensure appropriate accounting impact for SAP B1 transactions.
 



  Work with APIs, databases and third\-party applications for system integrations.
 



 3\. Business Analysis \& Process Management
 



  Engage with business stakeholders to understand business objectives, operational challenges
 



 and process requirements.
 



  Gather, document, analyze and validate business requirements across Retail, Finance,
 



 Production, Warehouse, HR and other business functions.
 



  Translate business requirements into functional requirements and SAP B1 solutions.
 



  Prepare BRD, FRD, process flows, functional specifications and requirement documents.
 



  Conduct fit\-gap analysis between existing processes and proposed SAP B1 solutions.
 



  Evaluate the impact of system changes on business processes, integrations, reporting and
 



 accounting.
 



  Identify opportunities for automation, process improvement and system optimization.
 



 4\. Testing \& UAT
 



  Prepare test scenarios and test cases based on business requirements.
 



  Coordinate and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
 



  Track defects and coordinate with technical teams for resolution.
 



  Validate system changes before deployment.
 



  Ensure system quality, integrity and business readiness.
 



 5\. Retail \& Warehouse Integration
 



  Support integration of SAP B1 with retail stores and warehouse management systems.
 



  Provide functional inputs for retail\-specific applications and processes.
 



  Support inventory, supply chain, warehouse and store operations.
 



  Ensure seamless data flow between SAP B1 and integrated systems.
 



 6\. Integration \& Technical Collaboration
 



  Work with developers, integration teams and third\-party vendors to implement SAP B1
 



 enhancements.
 



  Support API\-based integrations between SAP B1 and enterprise/third\-party applications.
 



  Participate in technical discussions and solution design.
 



  Coordinate with development teams for customization and system enhancements.
 



  Explore and support integration of AI solutions with SAP and enterprise systems where
 



 relevant.
 



 7\. Project \& Stakeholder Management
 



  Manage assigned SAP B1 projects and enhancement initiatives.
 



  Coordinate project timelines, resources and deliverables.
 



  Work closely with IT leadership, business users, functional teams, developers and vendors.
 



  Act as the primary point of contact for SAP B1 business requirements and functional
 



 discussions.
 



  Communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
 



 8\. Training \& Documentation
 



  Create and maintain user manuals, functional specifications and process documentation.
 



  Prepare process flow diagrams and requirement documentation.
 



  Conduct end\-user training and knowledge\-sharing sessions.
 



  Promote SAP B1 best practices across business functions.
 



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications:** 




  4–6 years of experience as an SAP B1 Techno Functional Consultant.
 



  Strong hands\-on experience in SAP Business One implementation, configuration,
 



 customization and support.
 



  Strong functional knowledge of SAP B1 Financials, Sales, Purchasing, Inventory, Warehouse
 



 and Production modules.
 



  Strong expertise in SAP HANA and SQL.
 



  Hands\-on experience with Crystal Reports and SAP B1 query generation.
 



  Experience with SAP B1 integrations, APIs and third\-party applications.
 



  Strong understanding of business requirement gathering, fit\-gap analysis, BRD/FRD,
 



 functional specifications and UAT.
 



  Strong understanding of accounting impact and financial processes within SAP B1\.
 



  Experience working with business stakeholders, developers, integration teams and vendors.
 



  Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or
 



 a related field.
 



  





**Preferred Skills:** 




  Experience in Retail, E\-commerce, Supply Chain, Warehouse or Inventory Management
 



 processes.
 



  Strong project management and stakeholder management experience.
 



  Willingness to travel as required.
 



  Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
 



  





**Application Method** 




 Apply on LinkedIn or email your resume to: careers@speedmart.co.in

* Coordinate NXDM releases and production patch deployments with clients, and support development teams in executing and validating parallel runs.

* Assist Numerix clients (financial institutions) with our API platform for market data related issues and queries.



  





  





**What We're Looking For:** 



* Bachelor’s degree from a leading engineering university, or equivalent professional experience.
* Good experience in Python for ad\-hoc data analysis and automating manual processes.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; practical exposure to SQL is beneficial for the role.
* Understanding of exchange\-traded and OTC derivatives (e.g., forwards, futures, options) across multiple asset classes, including IR, commodities, credit, equities, and FX. Familiarity with financial concepts such as volatility and beta is advantageous.
* Working Knowledge of Cloud Services, ideally AWS (Step Functions, Lambda, EC2, DynamoDB, etc.) is a plus.
* Strong troubleshooting abilities and good English communication skills.
* Willingness to work in US shift when required (3:00 PM to 11:30 PM MST).



  





  





**Extra Credit:** 



* Understanding of multiple asset classes (IR, Commodities, Credit, Equities, FX).
* Ability to use Excel, Python and SQL for ad\-hoc data analysis and investigation of market data issues.



  





  





**Where You’ll Work:** 




 This is a fully remote role open to anyone who is authorized to work in India.

**Job Summary**
 Bechtel is seeking a Senior Quality Engineer for the Manufacturing and Technology team, based in Gurugram, to support the Pharmaceutical Project in Houston. The Senior Quality Engineer will monitor and verify project quality activities to ensure compliance with approved standards, specifications, project procedures, GMP expectations, and schedule requirements through audits, surveillances, and quality reviews. The role includes supporting GMP\- and CQV\-related verification of engineering and procurement deliverables, including quality requirements, supplier documentation, inspection and test requirements, traceability, data integrity, turnover records, and readiness for commissioning, qualification, and validation. The Senior Quality Engineer will identify quality conditions, CQV gaps, and opportunities for improvement within the Project scope of work, and will support the Quality Lead in implementing the Project Quality Plan, audit plan, supplier quality program, Closed Loop Corrective Action process, quality metrics, and lessons learned program.
   

  

**Major Responsibilities**
* Support the Quality Lead in implementing the project Quality Management System with specific focus on CQV readiness during the Engineering and Procurement phases for Lilly Houston Project work executed from the India offices. Facilitate development and execution of the project audit and surveillance program to verify that Engineering and Procurement deliverables support commissioning, qualification, validation, and applicable GMP requirements.
* Review material and service requisitions, quality requirements, supplier data requirements, inspection points, and data \& documentation requirements to confirm that GMP\-critical systems, Non\-Impact systems equipment, utilities, and materials are properly defined for intended use.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Supplier Quality, CQV, and project stakeholders to ensure design outputs and procurement packages include requirements for equipment suitability, cleanability, maintainability, calibration, data integrity, traceability, and turnover documentation.
* Support supplier prequalification and quality submittal reviews for GMP\-relevant equipment and services, including verification of supplier quality capability, inspection and test requirements, and vendor turnover packages.
* Identify quality conditions, CQV gaps, specification inconsistencies, and potential cGMP compliance risks during Engineering and Procurement reviews; initiate documented actions and follow up through closure using the project Closed Loop Corrective Action process.
* Track nonconformities, audit findings, surveillance observations, and supplier quality issues that may affect CQV readiness, GMP compliance, or project turnover; verify effective closure with responsible Engineering, Procurement, Supplier Quality, and CQV stakeholders.
* Collect, analyze, and report quality metrics for Engineering and Procurement performance, including audit and surveillance completion, action closure, requisition review quality, supplier documentation status, and CQV/GMP readiness indicators.


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in an engineering, science, or technical discipline from an accredited college or university and a minimum of 11 years relevant industry experience including 7 plus years of GMP / Pharmaceuticals experience.


**Required Knowledge And Skills**
* Quality Management System knowledge, skills, and experience within regulated GMP environments within Pharma, Biotech, or Medical Devices supporting site startups, major expansions, or large capital projects with responsibility for QMS requirements.
* An understanding of aseptic manufacturing, utilities, equipment qualification, and data integrity principles (preferred 4 parenteral facilities). Working knowledge of GMP regulations, inspection readiness, validation, and quality systems.
* Extensive knowledge of Quality Assurance Requirements, and their application to construction, engineering, acquisition services, supplier quality, materials management, and regulatory requirements.
* Knowledge of advanced techniques for assessment, event investigation, cause analysis, human performance, and corrective action
* Demonstrated knowledge of design, procurement, construction, start\-up, commissioning, and operation. Demonstrated knowledge of current construction industry trends, innovations, and regulatory construct, for industry.
* Auditor professional certification from an accredited certification body. Previous experience in development and maintenance of quality assurance programs related to the construction of Pharmaceutical / Life Science facilities.
* Flexibility to respond to urgent project requests and/or changing priorities. Ability to work under pressure and with minimal supervision. Demonstrated ability to work with people of varied backgrounds and objectives.

 For decades, Bechtel has worked to inspire the next generation of employees and beyond! title: Senior Quality Analyst
description:
**About SaveIN** 
 : SaveIN is a Y\-Combinator\-backed fintech company on a mission to make financial products accessible and affordable for every Indian. We offer Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) and no\-cost EMI solutions through a growing network of Banks, NBFCs, and lending partners, enabling consumers to fund healthcare, education, and everyday needs without financial stress.
 



  





**About the Role** 
 : SaveIN is looking for a Senior QA Engineer with a strong automation focus to help us scale test coverage across our lending and payments platform. You'll work closely with engineering, product, and compliance teams to ensure the reliability, security, and correctness of systems that handle real money movement and sensitive customer data.
 



  





**Employment Type** 
 : Full\-Time
 



**Working Days:** 
 5 days a week
 



**Mode of Work:** 
 On\-Site
 



**Experience Required:** 
 3\-5 years
 



**Reporting To** 
 : CTO
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Design, build, and maintain automated test suites (API, UI, and regression) integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Own the test strategy for critical customer journeys, including onboarding, credit decisioning, disbursement, and repayment/collections.
* Build and maintain automation frameworks for testing integrations with bank partners (HDFC, ICICI, IDFC First) and bureau/KYC providers.
* Identify gaps in test coverage and proactively build automated regression suites to reduce manual QA dependency.
* Collaborate with developers to "shift testing left" by embedding test gates into CI/CD alongside SAST/security checks.
* Perform API contract testing, load/performance testing, and data validation for financial transactions.
* Write clear, reproducible bug reports and work with engineering to drive root\-cause fixes.
* Contribute to the test data management strategy, especially around PII/DPDP\-compliant sandbox data.
* Mentor junior QA engineers and help formalize QA processes, test documentation, and release sign\-off criteria.
* Participate in production incident reviews to identify testing gaps that could have caught issues earlier.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 3\-5 years of experience in QA/SDET roles with a strong hands\-on automation focus.
* Proficiency with automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman, RestAssured, Karate).
* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) and integrating automated tests.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data validation and backend testing.
* Experience testing REST APIs, webhooks, and third\-party integrations.
* Basic scripting ability (Java/Python/JavaScript) for writing and maintaining test scripts.
* Understanding of the software testing lifecycle, including test planning, traceability, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Prior experience in fintech, banking, or lending products is a strong plus (understanding of KYC, credit underwriting, or payment flows).
* Familiarity with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, k6\) is a plus.
* Exposure to security testing basics (e.g., OWASP Top 10\) is a plus, given the regulated environment.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Experience testing systems with multiple bank/NBFC integrations.
* Familiarity with compliance\-driven QA (e.g., audit trails, RBI/data protection considerations).
* Interest in AI\-assisted testing tools/agentic QA workflows, as this is a growing focus area for our team.

description:
**Location:**

 6 months, convertible to full\-time
 



  





**About Grade Capital** 




 Grade Capital is a long\-term investment platform for crypto portfolios. Our curated crypto baskets and mutual fund\-style portfolios are built on strict risk management, data\-driven research, and proven investment principles — designed for steady growth, not short\-term reactions.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 In fintech, a bug isn't cosmetic — it's someone's money. You won't be handed a script to click through. You'll learn to think adversarially about financial systems: where data drifts, what breaks under load, what happens when a price feed goes stale mid\-transaction.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  





 • Write and execute test cases across web and mobile — functional, regression, edge cases.
 



 • Test real financial flows: portfolios, transactions, order execution, data accuracy.
 



 • Log clear, reproducible bug reports with steps, evidence, and expected vs. actual.
 



 • Validate APIs with Postman; verify response contracts and error handling.
 



 • Cross\-check data integrity across UI, backend, and database.
 



 • Work directly with engineers through the fix–verify–close loop.
 



 • AI\-First Engineering (Non\-Negotiable).
 



  





**Core Requirements** 




  





 • Strong analytical and logical reasoning — you ask "what if" by instinct.
 



 • Sharp attention to detail: the off\-by\-one, the misaligned decimal, the missing null check.
 



 • QA fundamentals — STLC, test case design, bug life cycle, severity vs. priority.
 



 • Basics of REST APIs, JSON, and SQL for data verification.
 



 • Clear written communication; comfort with Jira, Postman, DevTools, Git.
 



  





**Strong Differentiators** 




  





 • Automation exposure (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress) or scripting in Java/JS/Python.
 



 • Interest in fintech, crypto, trading, or Web3\.
 



 • Personal projects, hackathons, open source, or bug bounty work.

description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.

**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 7 to 10 years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts

title: CQV Engineer
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
   

  

 Your impact
   

  

 The CQV Engineer will be responsible for the commissioning, qualification, and validation of equipment, systems, and processes used in the production of Drug substances/ Drug Product/ Sterile Facilities/ API/ OSDs, as well as the Utility system, HVAC system and Area. This role ensures that all systems operate as intended and comply with regulatory standards. The CQV Engineer will work closely with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Familiarity with risk\-based approaches to C\&Q (e.g., ASTM E2500, ISPE).
* Develop and execute commissioning and qualification lifecycle protocols for new and existing process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities.
* Prepare C\&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and as per regulatory requirements.
* Experienced in commissioning and qualifying CIP \& SIP systems
* Conduct risk assessments and gap analysis for process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities, to identify critical process parameters and control strategies.
* Participate in design document reviews and ensure that quality aspects are included in design.
* Developing system boundaries for the system at an early stage of C\&Q.
* Review vendor documents (CTOP/ VTOPs) to support commissioning and qualification requirements.
* Ensure non\-conformances or deviations are minimized during execution of CQV activities. For issues that do arise ensure they are closed out in a timely manner.
* Track and confirm closure of actions items identified through FAT, HAZOP, Design Qualification and other reviews.
* Perform shakedown during commissioning and qualification of systems on site.
* Field Walkdowns of systems as part of transfer of ownership of the system from Construction.
* System Startup activities
* Supervise vendors/ contractors on site during commissioning activities.
* Ensure compliance with current industry regulations and guidelines relating to Commissioning, qualification and validation.
* Prepare and maintain detailed documentation, including protocols, reports, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Ensure all CQV activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, EMA) and industry standards (e.g., ISPE, ASTM).
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless project execution.
* Provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders.


**Working Conditions**
* The position requires travel and/ or deputation to other sites or manufacturing facilities.
* Ability to work in a cleanroom environment and adhere to gowning requirements.
* Flexibility to work outside of regular business hours as needed to support project timelines


 Here's what you'll need
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm., M. Pharm., B.Tech or BE or MSc.
* 5\-8 year’s experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing.
* Experience with writing and executing commissioning, qualification, and validation of biopharmaceutical equipment and systems (e.g., bioreactors, chromatography systems, filtration systems)
* Experience in preparing Risk assessments for new and existing process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities.


**Technical Skills**
* Experience with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and/ or Valgenesis.
* Strong understanding of cGMP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
* Experience with process validation and computer system validation.
* Familiar with Delta\-V and other PCS/ DCS systems is an advantage.
* Familiarity with Construction management software such as EIDA, PIMS, Aconex, is an advantage


**Soft Skills**
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team


 At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
   

  

 Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
   

  

 At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.

title: Client Services and Administration
description:
Company Description
 



 Synergetic Communication Inc. is a debt collection agency focused on combining a customer\-centric approach with advanced technology to achieve effective delinquent account recovery. The company emphasizes innovation, using modern tools and streamlined processes to improve efficiency, transparency, and communication. Its compliance\-driven operations aim to foster trust and satisfaction among both clients and consumers. Team members are expected to balance strong results with respectful, empathetic interactions. Synergetic Communication Inc. is committed to redefining industry standards by aligning technology, communication, and positive consumer experiences.
 



  





 Role Description
 



 We are expanding our Client Services and Administration team with multiple full\-time, on\-site openings based in Gurugram, India. This team is the operational and compliance backbone of the business, supporting consumer interactions, data integrity, training delivery, quality assurance, audit readiness, and platform uptime. Candidates are encouraged to apply once and indicate in their application which function best matches their experience; we will consider applicants across all openings.
 



  





 Open Functions
 



  





 Consumer Disputes \- Research, document, and resolve consumer disputes end to end. Review account histories, gather supporting documentation, prepare written responses within regulatory timeframes, and escalate issues that require compliance or legal review.
 



  





 Data Entry \- Accurately enter, validate, and maintain account and consumer records across internal platforms. Reconcile incoming client files, correct data discrepancies, and maintain the record quality that downstream reporting and compliance depend on.
 



  





 Learning Management System Admin (LMS) \- Administer the company learning platform: build and publish courses, manage user accounts and permissions, assign and track required compliance training, troubleshoot learner issues, and report on completion rates and certification status.
 



  





 Quality Call Scoring \- Monitor and score recorded consumer calls against quality and compliance scorecards. Document findings, identify coaching opportunities and trends, and partner with operations leadership to raise consistency across the floor.
 



  





 Internal Audit Testwork \- Execute internal audit test procedures across operational and compliance controls. Pull and review samples, document evidence and exceptions, prepare clear workpapers, and support remediation tracking through to closure.
 



  





 System Monitoring Admin \- Monitor production systems, dialer platforms, and scheduled processes for availability and errors. Track alerts, run daily health checks, log and escalate incidents, and maintain monitoring documentation and shift handoff notes.
 



  





 Qualifications
 


* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to document work clearly and professionally.
* Solid computer proficiency, including Microsoft Excel and Word, and comfort learning new business platforms quickly.
* High attention to detail and accuracy when working with records, documentation, and consumer data.
* Ability to follow defined procedures, meet deadlines, and work within a regulated, compliance\-focused environment.
* Sound judgment in handling confidential and sensitive consumer information.
* Ability to work on\-site in Gurugram, India, on assigned shifts, and to collaborate with operations, compliance, and management teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience in BPO, collections, financial services, customer service, quality assurance, audit, or systems administration is an advantage.
* Function\-specific experience is preferred but not required: dispute handling or complaints for Consumer Disputes; high\-volume data processing for Data Entry; LMS or training coordination for LMS Admin; QA scorecards or call monitoring for Quality Call Scoring; audit or controls testing for Internal Audit Testwork; monitoring tools, ticketing, or basic SQL for System Monitoring Admin.



 Please indicate your preferred function or functions in your application.

title: Quality Control Engineer (Mechanical)
company: SVS Life Safety (a div of SVS Buildwel P Ltd)
description:
**Job title:** 
 QC Engineer — Fire Suppression Manufacturing \& Gas Cylinder Filling
 



**Company:** 
 SVS Buildwel Private Limited
 



**Location:** 
 Neetaji Subhash vihar Indl Area, Tikri, Delhi · On\-site
 



**Employment type:** 
 Full\-time · Mid\-Senior level
 



**Job function:** 
 Quality Assurance · Manufacturing
 



**Industry:** 
 Fire Protection / Industrial Machinery Manufacturing
 



**About SVS Buildwel** 




 SVS Buildwel has manufactured and installed fire safety and ELV systems for 18 years, serving government, PSU, metro, railway and hospital clients across India. Our Firetrex clean\-agent suppression systems are built in our own plant in Rohini, Delhi — not rebranded.
 



**The role** 




 We are creating a dedicated QC Engineer position at the plant.
 



 That matters more here than in most factories. A fire suppression system is only tested in a real emergency. A defect that escapes our gate is not discovered until the system is needed. You will be the last person between the shop floor and that moment.
 



 You will report to the DGM — Production, Planning \& QC.
 



**What you will do** 



* Incoming inspection of bought\-out material against specification, and collection of test certificates at receipt
* In\-process inspection at defined hold points on the line
* Final QC and functional testing on every unit before release
* Cylinder weighing, pressure testing and leak testing, with records maintained at serial level
* Own the calibration register for all gauges and instruments, and withdraw anything out of calibration
* Raise non\-conformance reports, drive disposition, and verify corrective action closes the root cause rather than the symptom
* Handle pre\-dispatch inspections by clients, consultants and third\-party inspectors — you will face them directly
* Maintain batch and serial traceability so any dispatched unit can be traced back to its material and its operator
* Feed quarterly warranty failure data back into production and design



**What you need** 



* Diploma or B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering
* 3–6 years in quality control in a manufacturing plant — pressure vessels, cylinders, valves, fire equipment, HVAC or comparable engineered products
* Hands\-on with pressure testing, leak testing, weighing and the associated record keeping
* Working knowledge of calibration control, and of raising and closing non\-conformance reports
* Able to read engineering drawings and a bill of materials, and inspect against a written specification rather than by eye
* Able to hold a rejection under commercial pressure. This is part of the job, not an edge case



**Nice to have** 



* Exposure to PESO requirements for gas cylinders and filling
* Experience facing client, consultant or third\-party pre\-dispatch inspection
* ISO 9001 quality system experience, including internal audit
* Exposure to clean agent systems — FK\-5\-1\-12, NOVEC, FM\-200 or similar



**Why this role** 




 You will not be inheriting someone else's quality system. There isn't one yet. You will define the hold points, build the records, set up calibration control, and decide what "passed" means at this plant — with direct access to the department head and no layer in between.
 



 If you have spent three or four years executing a QC plan somebody else wrote, this is the step where you write it.
 



**To apply:** 
 send your CV to dip@svslifesafety.com with "QC Engineer — Plant" in the subject line.

title: Product Quality Intern
description:
At Aftershoot, we’re building more than just AI tools; we’re building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post\-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world. From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.
   

  

 We’re a fast\-growing, passionate team backed over 100K\+ active users globally.
   

  

 But we’re just getting started. Our mission is clear: solve the biggest pain points in photography, and keep evolving with photographers who use our tools daily.
   

  

 If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

 Let’s create the future of AI in photography, together.
   

  

 🚀
 **About the Role**
 A wedding photographer shoots 4,000 photos on a Saturday.
   

  

 Before Aftershoot, that meant three nights hunched over a screen, clicking through near\-identical frames, missing dinner, missing their kids, missing the life they take pictures of for everyone else.
   

  

 With Aftershoot, it takes an hour.
   

  

 That hour is the entire product. 100,000\+ photographers around the world trust us with it. Culling, editing, retouching \- our AI does the grunt work so they can go back to doing the thing they actually love.
   

  

 Which means when we ship a bug, we don't ship an inconvenience. We ship somebody's ruined Sunday. That's where you come in.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Every engineer here builds a piece of the product. The PM holds the plan for it. Design holds the intent.
   

  

 You're the only person on the team whose entire job is to know what the product
 **actually does** 
 .
   

  

 Not what the ticket said. Not what the spec promised. What happens when a photographer drags in 12,000 RAW files, loses Wi\-Fi halfway through, closes the laptop lid, and reopens it four hours later on battery.
   

  

 We're not hiring you to tick boxes on a test sheet. You'll write code, own an automation suite, and hold the call on whether something is fit to go in front of 100,000 photographers. We're hiring you to become the person we can't ship without.
   

  

**Here's the bar we're setting, out loud:**
 Six months in, when an engineer and a PM disagree about how a flow is supposed to behave, someone in that room should say "just ask \[your name]" and that settles it.
   

  

 You will know this product better than the people who built it. That's not a stretch goal. That's the job.
   

  

**Required Skills**
* Basic programming in JavaScript or TypeScript
* Comfort with browser developer tools
* A grasp of testing fundamentals — test cases, severity, the defect lifecycle, what regression actually means
* Sharp analytical instincts and genuinely strong attention to detail
* Clear written and verbal communication (a bug report is writing)
* Real eagerness to learn automation, not just tolerance for it
* BE/B.Tech, BCA, MCA, or B.Sc in CS/IT — freshers and final\-year students very welcome


**Preferred Skills (Good To Have)**
* Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress
* Git / GitHub
* REST APIs and API testing
* Anything you've built and shipped yourself, however small


**You will work with**
* Captain: Neha
* Team Members: Vikas, Aditi and the rest of the Aftershoot team.

description:
**Job Purpose**
 A leading independent academic publishing company is seeking a Sr. QA Analyst to ensure the quality and reliability of its business systems. The ideal candidate will meticulously test and analyse our software applications to maintain the highest standards of performance and functionality.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
 The job functions include, but are not limited to, the following:
   

  

* Own test strategy for features and cross\-system initiatives, defining scope, approach, coverage, dependencies, and test requirements.
* Apply risk\-based testing to identify critical scenarios, regression scope, and integration risks, and determine what should be tested, deferred, or excluded based on requirements and business impact.
* Understand end\-to\-end system flows and integrations, including upstream/downstream impacts, APIs, data flows, and system dependencies.
* Define and review high\-level test scenarios for complex features and integrated products, ensuring coverage of key functional, negative, boundary, and business\-risk scenarios.
* Work closely with Product Owners and Engineers from the requirements stage to understand business and technical requirements, identify gaps, risks, and testability concerns, and provide QA input early in the lifecycle.
* Test complex features, integrations, and bug fixes using appropriate manual and technical testing techniques, including API and database testing, and investigate defects to identify root causes.
* Drive test automation by identifying suitable automation opportunities and independently developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting automation scripts in collaboration with automation engineers.
* Assess test results and quality risks, provide input on release readiness, and proactively communicate issues that may impact quality, timelines, or business outcomes.
* Mentor and guide QA team members on requirements, test strategy, scenario design, integrations, and troubleshooting, and review their test coverage where needed.
* Represent the QA team in cross\-functional discussions, clearly communicating testing status, risks, dependencies, and priorities, while maintaining strong relationships with Product, Engineering, and other QA teams.
* Coordinate integration testing for integrated products, working across teams to manage dependencies, test data, environments, and testing timelines.
* Contribute to improving automation coverage, QA practices, and test processes, including CI/CD integration where applicable.
* Contribute to hiring, onboarding, knowledge sharing, and QA process improvements, and actively participate in Agile ceremonies and team activities.
* Demonstrate ownership, curiosity, and sound judgment by proactively exploring system behaviour and business flows, raising risks early, and making informed testing decisions with minimal supervision.


**Technical Skills**
 Skills, Qualifications \& Experience
   

  

* Manual \& Regression Testing: Strong experience testing complex features and integrated systems, with a focus on regression coverage and system dependencies.
* Automation: Hands\-on experience developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting automation scripts using Python, PyTest, and Playwright, with an eagerness to quickly learn new programming languages, tools, and technologies. Experience identifying automation opportunities and improving automation coverage.
* Test Strategy \& Risk\-Based Testing: Ability to develop test strategies, define test scope, identify critical scenarios, and make risk\-based decisions on test coverage.
* Integration \& System Knowledge: Strong understanding of end\-to\-end business flows, system integrations, APIs, data flows, and upstream/downstream dependencies.
* Requirements \& Testability Analysis: Ability to analyse business and technical requirements, identify gaps, dependencies, risks, and testability concerns, and provide QA input early in the development lifecycle.
* Technical Troubleshooting \& Root Cause Analysis: Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across applications, APIs, databases, and integrated systems, using logs, data, and system behaviour to identify root causes.
* Test Management \& Defect Tracking: Experienced in test case/scenario design, execution, defect investigation, tracking, and resolution.
* API \& Database Testing: Hands\-on experience with API testing (e.g., Postman/SoapUI) and SQL/database validation; basic understanding of performance testing.
* Agile: Experience working in Agile teams and actively participating in planning, refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and other relevant ceremonies.
* QA Process Improvement: Contributes to QA standards, best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* GenAI: Experience using GenAI tools to improve QA efficiency, test design, analysis, and productivity.


**Soft Skills**
* Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management: Works effectively with Product Owners, Engineers, QA teams, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, dependencies, and risks.
* Communication: Clearly communicates technical information, testing status, risks, and recommendations to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Confidently communicates QA perspectives, challenges assumptions constructively, and influences technical and business decisions based on quality, risk, and customer impact.
* Curiosity \& Continuous Learning: Proactively explores systems, integrations, business processes, and new technologies to deepen understanding and identify potential risks.
* Mentorship: Guides QA team members on requirements, test scenarios, integrations, testing approaches, and troubleshooting.
* Problem\-Solving \& Decision\-Making: Uses critical thinking, technical analysis, and risk assessment to identify issues and make sound testing decisions.
* Ownership \& Accountability: Dependable in delivering commitments, proactively raises risks and blockers, and follows through on responsibilities with minimal supervision.
* Adaptability: Responds effectively to changing requirements, priorities, and business needs.
* Team Representation: Represents the QA team effectively in cross\-functional discussions and ensures QA perspectives, risks, and priorities are clearly communicated.
* Professional Maturity: Demonstrates sound judgment, emotional intelligence, composure, and the ability to balance technical, business, and team priorities.


**Work Requirements**
