title: Senior Staff Design Quality Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 CooperSurgical is a leading fertility and women’s healthcare company dedicated to putting time on the side of women, babies, and families at the healthcare moments that matter most in life. As a division of CooperCompanies, we're driven by a unified purpose to enable patients to experience life's beautiful moments. Guided by our shared values – dedicated, innovative, friendly, partners, and do the right thing – our offerings support patients throughout their lifetimes, from contraception to fertility and birth solutions, to women’s and family care, and beyond. We currently offer over 600 clinically relevant medical devices to healthcare providers, including testing and treatment options, as well as an innovative suite of assisted reproductive technology and genomic testing solutions. Learn more at www.coopersurgical.com.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The Senior Staff Design Quality Engineer will provide technical leadership to ensure the successful development of Cooper products and ongoing operational support. This individual will be expected to apply his/her knowledge of design controls, risk management, verification and validation principles and quality engineering techniques to ensure safe and effective products are developed and manufactured in accordance with applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements and customer requirements.
   

  

 The Senior Staff Design Quality Engineer provides expert guidance on scientific and technical data as it pertains to product and product testing and lead teams to identify and solve complex product problems. This position partners cross\-functionally with R\&D, Operations, Regulatory, Supplier Quality, and Clinical teams, and provides mentorship (including coaching, reviewing, training, delegating work) to peers, leads and less experienced DQEs, and cross\-functional engineering teams.
   

  

* Design Quality Leadership
+ Represent the Quality function on product/process development teams.
+ Mentor other discipline as needed in the Quality Engineering methodology.
+ Ensures that design control requirements are being met in an effective manner, including those for design verification, validation, specification and procedure development, risk management, design reviews, and design changes. May serve as independent reviewer during design reviews, or conduct DHF audits, as required.
+ Owner/Approver of one or more processes within the scope of Design Quality.

* Supplier Engagement
+ Manage supplier new tooling to ensure final components are qualified at the supplier and on time utilizing PPAP tool.
+ Participates in supplier selection process and specification reviews with suppliers to ensure that purchased items meet Cooper’s specifications.
+ Specifies quality characteristics and inspection plans for components, subassemblies, and finished devices with the Engineering Team.
+ Review/Approval of PPAP. May serve as PPAP lead.

* CAPAs/Non conformances/HHE
+ Lead or Participate in the investigation of complex product problems. Identify and manage corrective actions resulting from problem investigations.
+ Evaluates and dispositions nonconforming materials and products used in pilot and clinical builds.
+ Conducts or supports health risk assessments in support of the Health Hazard Evaluation, Reporting or Recall processes.

* Design
+ Participate in design reviews to evaluate designs and to help identify alternative design solutions.
+ Hands on participant in early stages of product development including but not limited to physician interaction, product engineering, competitive product testing, and prototype testing.
+ Provides input to design and manufacturing documentation including material specifications, drawings, inspection procedures, and manufacturing procedures, to ensure that the resulting products can be adequately manufactured and tested
+ Contributes to design input requirements from experience with previously reported problems, Cooper’s products, competitive devices and/or other similar products.
+ Approves deviations and design changes, conducts impact assessments, and defines/approves implementation plans.

* Verification \& Validation
+ Participate in the development of the master test plans (I.E. trace matrix, VMP….) that encompass design verification, design validation and process validation activities.
+ Creation, evaluation, and validation of product and process test methods.
+ Evaluates test protocols and reports to ensure that the testing is sufficient to meet regulatory requirements and quality objectives.

* Risk Management
+ Defines risk management strategy throughout product lifecycle including construction of the Risk Management File, Risk Management Planning, and benefit\-risk evaluations.
+ Identifies and manages risk throughout the development process with the use of FMEAs and/or other risk management tools, ensuring effective integration of risk activities throughout product realization process and feedback into design improvements and maintenance of the product risk profile. This includes leading the Risk management efforts of the design process and working with design team and management team on managing product and process risks.

* Process Improvement and Project Management
+ Leads strategic initiatives as aligned with organizational quality objectives. May manage a cross functional team to execute plans.
+ Actively identifies and leads opportunities for improvements across all cross functional departments.
+ Promotes continuous improvement in design control and risk management activities and use of quality tools with design team and other departments.

* Regulatory
+ Comply with applicable FDA and international regulatory laws/standards and the Cooper’s Code of Conduct.
+ Maintain knowledge of current regulatory requirements and standards as they pertain to the development and release of medical devices. Implement new or updated standards into existing procedures.
+ Represent Cooper as needed in FDA, notified body, internal, and other audits.

* Technical Mentorship
+ Serve as a technical mentor to QEs, providing guidance on complex quality engineering topics.
+ Promote continuous improvement and consistent application of design quality tools and methodologies.
+ Acts as a recognized subject matter expert in one or more DQE domains across the organization.

* Thorough knowledge of statistics and how to apply, evaluate, and provide recommendation from the data.
* Perform other duties as assigned.


**Qualifications**
* Advanced working knowledge of FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820\), ISO 13485, EU MDR.
* Demonstrated knowledge in the application of medical device design controls, verification/validation, risk management principles per ISO 14971, and the use of risk assessment tools such as FMEA, Hazard Analysis.
* Intermediate skill in the use of Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Advanced preferred.
* Ability to read and understand highly technical material.
* Proficient in reading and writing in English
* Self\-motivated and committed to a team approach
* Strong interpersonal, organizational and project management skills. Ability and experience interfacing with senior leadership and external stakeholders.
* Strong oral, presentation and technical writing skills
* Demonstrated skills in decision making, problem solving, negotiation, and influencing without direct authority preferably across a broad spectrum of Quality Engineering responsibilities
* Proven experience leading cross\-functional teams in a medical device development environment.
* Experience with Change Control, Non\-conformance, Deviation, Complaints, HHEs and/or CAPAs.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with acute attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Knowledge in Knowledge in application of IEC 62304 preferred.
* Knowledge in one or more ISO 10993, IEC 62366, ISO 11607, ISO 11137, or ISO 11135 preferred.


**Experience:**
* 10\+ years experience in Quality Engineering in the medical device industry with a Bachelors Degree, or 8\+ years with a Masters Degree, experience in related engineering areas, e.g. R\&D; or Manufacturing may also be applicable if experience includes work responsibilities listed above.
* Hands ‑ on experience in medical device product development in concept through commercialization, and/or leading design changes, improvements or remediation initiatives in sustaining operations. Knowledge in women’s health a plus.
* This role require 50% travelling \- Globally

M\&T strives to exceed our customer objectives through utilizing our agility, innovative technologies, and world class talent. M\&T solves the industry's toughest challenges, building both our company and the world for the future. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, the M\&T global business unit also includes colleagues working in Arizona, Ohio, Texas, India, and additional project locations around the world.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Bechtel is seeking a Lead Quality Engineer for the Manufacturing and Technology team, based in Gurugram/Chennai. The Quality Lead shall lead and mentor quality team members and monitor the project quality activities to ensure compliance with the approved standards, specifications and schedule through the implementation of a project audit and surveillance plan agreed with project stakeholders.
   

  

 The Quality Lead will identify and advise on Quality Conditions and opportunities for improvements within the Bechtel India scope of work. The Lead is responsible for developing and implementing the Project Audit Plan and for reviewing compliance with the Project Quality Management System (QMS). The Lead will work to implement the CLCA (Close Loop Corrective Action), People based Quality and Lesson learned program in coordination with the CAP and Project Quality Manager.
   

  

**Major Responsibilities**
* Responsible for effective implementation of the Quality Management System (QMS) and verifying it by conducting audits and surveillances on project activities.
* Directs quality programs on the project including Closed loop corrective action, Audit and surveillances plan, Quality dashboard, Lessons learned, Surveys and Trainings to enrich quality culture.
* Coordinates the preparation of and establishes the Audit and Surveillances plan for the project.
* Directs quality audits and surveillances on the project, communicating with functions and services to ensure management goals and objectives are met.
* Identify potential performance risks associated with quality during project planning including development and implementation of mitigation plans.
* Work collaboratively with Engineering, procurement, and Supplier Quality team on the Project to validate material and equipment meets design requirements, safety and performance parameters and are compliant to requirements.
* Energize the People based Quality Culture within the project. Lead the project in establishing and continually improving quality culture through fostering Quality behavior.
* Reviews and approves quality related procedures to ensure compliance with the project quality plan.
* Manages complex organizational interactions with project functions, services, and client.
* Represents the project during quality assurance audits conducted by the client, management, or regulatory agencies.
* Identifies quality problems, initiates documented action and verifies implementation of solutions.
* Reviews/approves Material/Service requisitions and verify all the requirements are captured appropriately.
* Perform supplier pre\-qualification, review quality submittals and coordinate with Engineering/ procurement team for supplier qualification.
* Support in developing Quality metrics dashboard for the project and collects data for monthly Quality metrics reporting.
* Supervises and participates in the project auditing and monitoring program to verify the effectiveness of the project quality program/plan.
* Ensures Team members are adequately trained, certified and assigns work to and directs the activities of assigned quality personnel.
* Reviews project schedules for quality related activities to ensure timely and effective implementation of the project quality plan.


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering, Science, or technical discipline from an accredited college or university and a minimum of 15 years industry experience with demonstrated leadership component and/or quality assurance program management experience in EPC or closely related industry preferably in establishing semiconductor facility.


**Minimum Qualifications**
**Required Knowledge and Skills:**
* Extensive knowledge of Quality Assurance requirements, and their application to construction, engineering, acquisition services, supplier quality, materials management, and regulatory requirements.
* Demonstrated proficiency in implementation and management of quality assurance programs.
* Knowledge of advanced techniques for assessment, event investigation, cause analysis, human performance, and corrective action.
* Demonstrated leadership in management of change initiatives.
* Demonstrated knowledge of design, procurement, construction, start\-up, commissioning, and operation.
* Successful track record of leading teams in complex environments.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Integrated Lead Auditor certification from an accredited body.
* Previous experience in development and maintenance of quality assurance programs related to the construction of semiconductor facility.
* Flexibility to respond to urgent project requests and/or changing priorities with minimal supervision.
* Demonstrated ability to work with people of varied backgrounds and objectives.

 For decades, Bechtel has worked to inspire the next generation of employees and beyond! Because our teams face some of the world's toughest challenges, we offer robust benefits to ensure our people thrive. Whether it is advancing careers, delivering programs to enhance our culture, or providing time to recharge, Bechtel has the benefits to build a legacy of sustainable growth. Learn more at Bechtel Total Rewards

 As a global company, Bechtel has long been home to a vibrant multitude of nationalities, cultures, ethnicities, and life experiences. This diversity has made us a more trusted partner, more effective problem solvers and innovators, and a more attractive destination for leading talent.

title: Customer Engineer
description:
**About GoKwik**
 GoKwik is a growth operating system designed to power D2C and eCommerce brands — from checkout optimization and reducing return\-to\-origin (RTO), to payments, retention, and post\-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik enables over 12,000 merchants worldwide, processes around $2 billion in GMV, and is strengthening its AI\-powered infrastructure.
   

  

 Backed by RTP Global, Z47, Peak XV, and Think Investments and bolstered by a $13 million growth round in June 2025 (total funding: $68 million), GoKwik is scaling aggressively across India, the UK, Europe, and the US.
   

  

**Why This Role Matters**
 As GoKwik continues to expand its eCommerce enablement stack, the Implementation team plays a key role in onboarding, enabling, and empowering our merchant partners. This role is at the intersection of product, engineering, and merchant success — responsible for gathering requirements, implementing SaaS solutions, and supporting merchants with integration and product adoption. You’ll be the tech enabler who ensures merchants derive maximum value from GoKwik’s solutions.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
**Product Implementation \& Integration**
* Collaborate with D2C merchants to gather requirements and create detailed Business Requirement Documents (BRDs)
* Implement GoKwik’s SaaS products across platforms like Shopify, WooCommerce, and Magento
* Support integration via APIs, SDKs, and ensure smooth onboarding and go\-live


**Technical Customer Support**
* Serve as the technical point of contact for merchant teams during and post\-integration
* Troubleshoot implementation issues across web, iOS, and Android
* Assist with tagging tools (Google Ads, Facebook Pixels) and other analytics integrations


**Internal Collaboration \& Feedback Loops**
* Coordinate with product, engineering, and customer success teams to improve merchant experience
* Share feedback and insights to drive product improvements and scalable processes
* Manage multiple merchant projects and prioritize work to meet business timelines


**Merchant Experience \& Enablement**
* Deliver prompt and clear communication to technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Ensure merchants are set up for long\-term success with GoKwik’s suite of products
* Monitor implementation milestones, escalate roadblocks, and ensure timely delivery


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field
* 3\+ years of experience in a client\-facing Implementation Engineer or Integration Support role
* Hands\-on experience with Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento integrations
* Strong understanding of APIs, SDKs, and web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
* Familiarity with ad tech tools like Google Ads and Facebook Pixel
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and non\-technical teams
* Strong multitasking and project management skills


**Why GoKwik**
 At GoKwik, you're not just building tech — you're building the future of eCommerce. We work fast, solve real\-world problems, and obsess over merchant success. Our culture values speed, ownership, and continuous innovation. If you thrive in high\-growth environments, love collaborating with smart, driven people, and want to be part of a mission\-driven team, we’d love to meet you.

title: ServiceNow ITSM Techno-Functional Consultant
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 To support the Service Automation team within Siemens Energy's Digital Core, this role is established to backfill capacity and address the increased workload from expanded responsibilities and upcoming strategic Energy Now initiatives. Operating at the Experienced Professional (P2\) level in India, the consultant will ensure operational stability, service excellence, and successful execution across key service areas. To address these business aims, the role focuses on ServiceNow ITSM solution design, platform configuration, and stakeholder collaboration. These core areas ensure alignment between business processes and technical implementations while driving out\-of\-the\-box (OOTB) adoption and minimizing platform customizations.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* ServiceNow Solution Design \& Implementation
+ Design and deliver scalable, upgrade\-safe solutions across ServiceNow ITSM modules (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge Management) leveraging out\-of\-the\-box (OOTB) capabilities.
+ Configure core platform architecture, including Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, custom scripting, and third\-party tool integrations (e.g., Snowflake, Jira, Salesforce).
+ Implement and manage technical integrations using REST, SOAP, MID Server, and Import Sets, ensuring alignment with platform security models and ACLs.
+ Promote OOTB adoption, minimize unnecessary customizations, and leverage ServiceNow AI capabilities to deliver efficient solutions.

* Functional Consulting \& Stakeholder Management
+ Conduct discovery workshops and sessions with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and translate requirements into functional specifications.
+ Prepare comprehensive design documents and define acceptance criteria to guide technical teams and review final solution designs.
+ Provide strategic recommendations on ServiceNow best practices, process optimization, and alignment with CMDB, CSDM, and SPM modules.

* Project Delivery \& Operational Support
+ Collaborate within Agile/Scrum and SAFe delivery environments to support the execution of strategic EnergyNow projects and initiatives.
+ Perform acceptance testing, validate solutions against requirements, and coordinate deployment activities with delivery partners to ensure operational stability.


**What You Bring**
* 6 to 8 years of professional experience in ServiceNow ITSM implementation and techno\-functional consulting.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – IT Service Management (CIS\-ITSM).
* ServiceNow ITSM implementation and techno\-functional consulting experience.
* ServiceNow Core Architecture \& Administration.
* Flow Designer \& IntegrationHub Configuration.
* ServiceNow Scripting \& Customization Best Practices.
* Integration Technologies (REST, SOAP, MID Server, Import Sets).
* IT Service Management (ITSM) Process Design.
* Common Service Data Model (CSDM) \& CMDB.
* Requirement Gathering \& Business Systems Analysis.
* Solution Architecture \& Design Documentation.
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Communication.
* Agile/Scrum \& SAFe Methodologies.
* Analytical Problem\-Solving.


**About The Team**
 Our Corporate and Global Functions play a critical role in driving Siemens Energy’s strategic initiatives and ensuring operational excellence across departments, business areas, and regions. As part of this team, you will contribute to shaping the global energy transition, partner with internal and external stakeholders, and conduct business responsibly while adhering to legal and regulatory requirements.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

title: Founding member, Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**Are you looking to join an organization that is growing and dynamic? What about a high\-energy, collaborative environment that rewards hard work?**




 J.S. Held is a global consulting firm that combines technical, scientific, financial, and strategic expertise to advise clients seeking to realize value and mitigate risk. Our professionals serve as trusted advisors to organizations facing high stakes matters demanding urgent attention, staunch integrity, proven experience, clear\-cut analysis, and an understanding of both tangible and intangible assets.
   

  





 The firm provides a comprehensive suite of services, products, and data that enable clients to navigate complex, contentious, and often catastrophic situations.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 The Quality Assurance Engineer is responsible for ensuring the reliability, accuracy, and performance of J.S. Held’s enterprise applications by designing and executing comprehensive testing strategies. This role plays a key part in reducing operational risk, improving user experience, and ensuring the consistent delivery of high\-quality solutions across integrated systems.
   

  





 As an early member of J.S. Held’s growing hub in Delhi, India, this individual will join a newly expanding team and have the unique opportunity to help shape quality assurance practices, contribute to operational excellence, and support the development of a high\-performing regional presence. Working alongside other new hires, this role will play an important part in establishing processes, fostering collaboration, and building a strong foundation for the hub’s continued growth and success.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities**




**Test Strategy \& Planning**



* Develop and execute QA strategies for enterprise applications and integrations
* Define test plans, test cases, and acceptance criteria aligned to business requirements
* Partner with Product Managers and Business Analysts to ensure adequate test coverage
* Take ownership in establishing and enhancing QA methodologies, processes, and governance practices, demonstrating a proactive and self\-directed approach to quality assurance initiatives
* Bring a Builder Mindset and take ownership in establishing and enhancing QA methodologies, processes, and governance practices, demonstrating a proactive and self\-directed approach to quality assurance initiatives



**Test Execution \& Automation**



* Perform functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing support
* Build and maintain automated test scripts where applicable
* Validate accuracy of workflows across time, expense, billing, and project systems
* Demonstrate a hands\-on, results\-oriented mindset with the ability to independently identify quality risks, drive testing activities, and deliver solutions with minimal supervision



**Performance Testing Competency**



* Design and execute non\-functional testing including performance, load, and reliability validation
* Validate system behavior under failure conditions (timeouts, API errors, downstream failures)
* Manage test environments and coordinate test data setup across systems
   

  

 • Ensure test data accuracy, completeness, and alignment with production scenarios
* Perform API testing including request/response validation, schema verification, and error handling scenarios
* Validate authentication, authorization, and data exchange patterns across integrations
* Execute release validation, including smoke testing and post\-deployment verification
* Validate rollback procedures and ensure production readiness prior to release
* Collaborate effectively with globally distributed teams and stakeholders across multiple time zones to support testing, release, and project commitments
* Maintain schedule flexibility, when required, to accommodate meetings, testing activities, and critical project milestones involving team members across different regions and UTC time zones



**Defect Management \& Resolution**



* Identify, document, and track defects through resolution
* Collaborate with engineering and product teams to prioritize fixes
* Ensure releases meet defined quality and performance standards



**Integration \& Data Validation**



* Validate end\-to\-end workflows across multiple interconnected systems
* Ensure data integrity across ERP, workflow tools, and reporting platforms
* Support testing of APIs, data pipelines, and system integrations



**Continuous Improvement**



* Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements to reduce defects
* Contribute to QA best practices, standards, and documentation
* Support enhancements to release management and testing processes
* Act as Player/Coach, mentor, and support team members in developing QA and testing skills, promoting best practices and fostering a quality\-first mindset across the team
* Contribute to building and maturing the organization's QA processes, standards, and testing frameworks through a proactive and continuous improvement approach


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* 8\+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing
* Experience with enterprise applications, ERP systems, or multi\-system integrations
* Familiarity with test automation tools (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, or similar)
* Experience with test case management and defect tracking tools (e.g., Azure DevOps)
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail



**Preferred Attributes**



* Experience in professional services or consulting environments
* Understanding of Agile/Scrum development methodologies
* Ability to work across distributed teams and complex system landscapes


**Additional Information**

**Some of the Benefits We Have Include**




 J.S. Held understands all our employees are people and sometimes life needs flexibility. We work to always provide an environment that best supports and suits our team’s needs.
   

  




* Our flexible work environment allows employees to work remotely, when needed
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Commuter Benefit



**Other Duties**




 Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
   

  





 By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read the J.S. Held Online Privacy Notice and hereby freely and unambiguously give informed consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of your personal information as required and described therein. California residents can click here to learn more about the personal information we collect and here to learn about additional privacy rights that may be available.
   

  





 Please explore what we’re all about at www.jsheld.com.
   

  





**EEO and Job Accommodations**




*We embrace diversity and our commitment to building a team and environment that fosters professional and personal enrichment is unwavering. We are greater when we are equal!*




*J.S. Held is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to hiring a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

*jobs@jsheld.com* 
*and include “Applicant Accommodation” within the subject line with your request and contact information.*

 systematically reduce errors and rework.

 content, coaching individuals, and lifting overall team competency and consistency.

title: Supplier Quality Inspector
description:
Company Overview:
   

  

 If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you’re searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve’s position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Here, your opportunity for professional development and industry leading rewards will be supported by our foundational commitments to the values of people first, integrity and safety. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone!
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 The Supplier Quality Inspector is responsible for supplier inspection, supplier quality development, and resolution of quality issues related to castings, forgings, patterns, machined parts, and associated mechanical pump components. This role works closely with suppliers and internal cross\-functional teams to ensure product conformity, regulatory compliance, robust manufacturing processes, and continuous quality improvement.
   

  

**Roles and Responsibilities:**
 Manage incoming and source inspection activities for bought\-out items, including castings, forgings, patterns, machined components, and mechanical instruments. Review supplier quality documentation, including inspection reports, quality plans, Material Test Certificates (MTCs), and manufacturing records, to confirm compliance with drawings, specifications, standards, and company requirements. Interpret engineering drawings, GD\&T requirements, dimensional tolerances, surface\-finish requirements, material specifications, and inspection criteria. Conduct and support supplier process reviews to assess manufacturing capability, process control, repeatability, and product quality consistency. Develop, implement, and support supplier SOPs, inspection plans, process risk assessments, and mitigation actions. Identify quality issues at supplier locations during manufacturing, investigate root causes, and support timely containment, corrective actions, and process improvements. Lead NCR management with suppliers, ensuring effective root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, verification of effectiveness, and timely closure. Plan and conduct supplier audits for supplier qualification, periodic evaluations, quality\-performance improvement, and problem\-resolution activities. Coordinate and review NDT/NDE activities, as applicable, including:
   

  

* Visual Testing (VT)
* Magnetic Particle Testing (MT)
* Penetrant Testing (PT)
* Ultrasonic Testing (UT)
* Radiographic Testing (RT)
* Positive Material Identification (PMI)
* Hardness Testing


 Coordinate third\-party inspection activities, including scheduling, inspection readiness, documentation review, and follow\-up on observations or nonconformities. Ensure supplier compliance with ISO 9001:2015 QMS requirements, applicable material standards, API, ASME, ASTM \& ISO standards, customer requirements, and internal quality procedures. Work effectively with Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, Project Management, and Quality teams to resolve supplier\-related technical and quality concerns. Maintain clear communication with suppliers and internal stakeholders regarding inspection status, quality concerns, corrective\-action progress, and delivery\-impact risks. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen supplier capability, reduce repeat defects, improve process controls, and prevent recurrence of quality issues.
   

  

**Key Competencies:**
* Supplier quality management
* Casting, forging, pattern, and machining inspection
* Supplier audits and compliance management
* Engineering drawing interpretation and GD\&T
* Material certification and MTC review
* NDT/NDE coordination and evaluation
* NCR, CAPA, and corrective\-action management
* Root cause analysis and structured problem solving
* Process risk analysis and mitigation
* Continuous improvement
* Cross\-functional coordination
* Analytical thinking
* Ownership, accountability, and effective communication


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 6 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Supplier Quality, or Inspection, preferably in manufacturing, metal\-mechanical, pumps, casting, forging, Fabrications or heavy\-engineering industries.
* Hands\-on inspection experience with castings, forgings, patterns, machined components, Fabricated components and related mechanical parts.
* Strong ability to interpret engineering drawings, dimensional requirements, GD\&T, surface finish, material specifications, and inspection standards.
* Experience reviewing MTCs, inspection reports, NDT reports, dimensional reports, and supplier quality documentation.
* Knowledge of API, ASME, ASTM \& ISO standards, material standards, and ISO 9001:2015 quality\-management\-system requirements.
* Strong Knowledge in ASME standards Section II, V, VIII \& IX
* NDT Level II certification and practical experience in relevant methods such as VT, MT, PT, UT, RT, PMI, and hardness testing is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in supplier audits, root cause analysis, CAPA, NCR management, and supplier corrective\-action follow\-up.
* Ability to travel 70% to various regions of supplier locations for inspections, audits, supplier development, and quality issue resolution.
* Experience in pump, pressure\-containing equipment, or rotating\-equipment manufacturing.
* Familiarity with third\-party inspection agencies and customer inspection requirements.
* Experience applying quality tools such as 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram, 8D, PFMEA, Control Plans, and Process Capability Analysis.
* Candidate preferably in the region of Kolhapur \& Sangli region.


 Flowserve is a world\-leading manufacturer and aftermarket service provider of comprehensive flow control systems. Our team challenges themselves to approach each situation with ingenuity and creativity to help provide our customers with the most innovative flow control products and services. description:
**About QCI** 




 The Quality Council of India (QCI) is the Scheme Owner of the Certification Scheme for Unmanned Aircraft Systems (CSUAS), which was notified in official gazette by the Ministry of Civil Aviation on 26 January 2022\. The scheme has since been revised and its scope enhanced, evolving into a Type based certification framework that covers Visual Line of Sight (VLOS) and Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) UAS operations, and it also promotes the indigenisation and development of the domestic drone industry, contributing to the vision of India becoming a global drone hub by 2030\.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 As part of the team, you contribute to the development and operation of a national certification framework for UAS. Our work spans into designing and developing certification schemes aligned with international best practice, formulating technical standards, and creating certification ecosystems in partnership with industry, regulators, ministries, academia and other stakeholders, scale them through conformity assessment bodies. Deep understanding of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS is essential.
 



  





 The next phase of this work is about collaborating with the industry on the segments that still need enabling, namely autonomous drones, Drone\-as\-a\-Service and UAS traffic management, along with the digital transformation that simplifies compliance and the aggregator led facilitation that scales the use\-case adaptation to advance the growth of Industry These are areas where the standards, the quality assurance mechanisms and in some cases the market itself are still taking shape, and the people who join us now will help shape the Nation’s Drone Ecosystem.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibility** 




 QCI is seeking professionals to support the implementation of CSUAS. The role will contribute to the development and operation of the CSUAS workstreams below:
 



  




* **Scheme Design \& Development** 
 : Conceptualise UAS related quality interventions that help the industry and the regulator, and develop and revise the scheme criteria, technical standards and guidelines that give them effect with a in\-depth understanding of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS.



  




* **Research, Analysis \& Knowledge Products** 
 : Conduct rapid primary and secondary research on UAS domain and policy, including comparative study of standards and international best practice to draft standards for UAS and its components.



  




* **Report Writing \& Deck Preparation:** 
 Draft and structure reports, concept notes, technical circulars and knowledge products, and create data driven presentations for relevant stakeholders.



  




* **Scheme Operations** 
 : Lead the day to day operations of the scheme and its projects, scheme documentation, deliverables, work plans, trackers and minutes of meetings and report periodically on developments; collect, clean and analyse scheme data and maintain its records, website and dashboard; propose the features and changes required in the dashboard to support operations; monitor scheme\-related activities; coordinate with vendors and internal and external stakeholders; and frequently update FAQs.



  




* **Stakeholder Engagement** 
 : Identify key stakeholders, analyse their expectations, and develop and execute appropriate strategies to work with them; manage and regularly engage multiple stakeholders i.e., regulators, Certification Bodies, manufacturers, assessors, technical experts, laboratories and academia to ensure timely information exchange and seamless coordination.



  




* **Business Development \& Marketing of the Scheme** 
 : Ensure quantitative improvement in the number of Certification Bodies; identify potential clients and partners for adoption of the scheme; market the scheme to increase its uptake; and develop a comprehensive plan to improve scheme processes and revenue generation.



  





**Why this Role is a Unique Opportunity** 



* This is not a typical corporate role and the work you do here is not theoretical. You will be at the epicentre of the drone ecosystem, translating the Viksit Bharat @ 2047 vision into actionable, on\-the\-ground projects. We at QCI drive large scale programs that impacts millions of lives, not just produce reports and opinion pieces.



  




* We are looking for individuals those who want to look back at their careers and point to a specific national program and say, "I helped in building that”. If you have the intellectual rigor, a strong commitment to public service, and the resilience to navigate complex challenges, this is the place for you.



  





**Eligibility Criteria \& Requirements** 




**Educational Qualification** 
 :
 



  




* A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline is required. A Bachelor’s degree in a related engineering discipline, coupled with strong relevant experience, may also be considered for the Associate Manager role.



  




* An additional qualification in management, public policy, or conformity assessment ecosystem, or quality and compliance, or training in ISO/IEC 17065, ISO/IEC 17067, or ISO/IEC 17024, or ISO/IEC 17020, or ISO 9001 will be considered a strong added advantage.



  





**Experience:** 



* Minimum three years of professional work experience in areas including manufacturing, R\&D, operations, consulting (private or government), or testing, auditing or a managerial role specifically in drone industry, or should have experience with stakeholder management, or operating a certification scheme, or national program.



  




* Knowledge of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS is essential, along with knowledge of the relevant rules and regulations with respect to drones operations in India and type certification.



  




* Excellent Microsoft Office skills, strong verbal communication, and sound organisational and planning skills, with a proven ability to multitask and meet tight deadlines, are required.



  




* Experience in marketing of products and creation of knowledge products is desired. Prior experience of working with government agencies, regulators or CABs in any capacity (operations or consulting) will be preferred.



  




* Working experience in any programming language, or with dashboards and AI tools, would be an added advantage. Exposure to UAS design, manufacturing, testing or flight operations, including VLOS/BVLOS flying experience, will be preferred though not mandatory.



  




* Fluency in English, both written and oral, is required. Fluency in Hindi, both written and oral, is desired.



  




* Location for the role is based out of New Delhi, on a full time engagement, with travel anywhere in India or abroad as and when required.



  




* The expected remuneration for this role would be between 5 to 10 LPA



  





**Technical Capabilities:** 




**Strong Research Skills:** 
 Ability to rapidly identify, read, and understand dense, technical documents (e.g., government reports and research papers) and extract the most relevant information.
 



**Structured Thinking \& Writing:** 
 Ability to break down large, ambiguous topics into a structured research plan and produce clear, logical, professional, and well\-written outputs.
 



**Data Analysis:** 
 Comfortable with data cleaning, essential MS Excel functions, and creating charts. Experience analysing survey data using Stata, R, or Python is an added advantage.
 



**Visualization \& Presentation Skills:** 
 Strong data\-visualization skills using MS Office Suite, with Tableau/Power BI proficiency being an added advantage; ability to create well\-structured and visually compelling presentations.
 



  





**Behavioural Capabilities:** 




**High Degree of Curiosity:** 
 Genuine interest in how India’s public policy and governance systems work; naturally follows current affairs and asks “why.”
 



**Integrity \& Accountability:** 
 Takes ownership of tasks, delivers on commitments, and upholds the highest ethical standards in all work and workplace interactions.
 



**Meticulous Attention to Detail:** 
 Able to identify typos, formatting errors, inconsistencies, and mismatched numbers that others may overlook.
 



**Proactive \& “Get\-it\-Done” Attitude:** 
 Self\-starter who takes complete ownership of tasks, anticipates what needs to be done, and delivers results without waiting for instructions.

title: Lead- Photography Ops and QC
description:
At Aftershoot, we’re building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post\-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world.
   

  

 From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.
   

  

 We’re a fast\-growing, passionate team backed over 100K\+ active users globally. Double\-digit ARR in less than 4 years, amazing investors and team who truly believe in our mission.
   

  

 Our mission is clear: Become the default companion for every photographer in the world.
   

  

 If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

 Let’s create the future of AI in photography, together.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role sits at the intersection of photography craft, quality operations, and people leadership.
   

  

 As Lead – Photography Ops, you'll own the engine that feeds our AI: the datasets, the standards they're labelled against, and the team of QCs and vendor partners who do that work. You'll set the quality bar from a photographer's point of view, then build the systems, rubrics, and rhythms that keep it consistent at scale.
   

  

 You'll be the bridge between what photographers actually expect from a cull and what our ML and Product teams build toward. When the two drift apart, you're the person who spots it, quantifies it, and drives it back into alignment.
   

  

 If you've shot professionally, have led teams or vendors, and get satisfaction from turning subjective taste into a repeatable standard, this role is for you.
   

  

**💼 What you’ll do:**
* Own the photography QC function end to end: quality standards, capacity, and turnaround
* Hire, train, and manage a team of in\-house QCs and reviewers
* Manage external labelling vendors: scoping, onboarding, SLAs, capacity planning, and cost
* Build and maintain labelling guidelines, rubrics, and edge\-case documentation
* Run regular calibration sessions to keep reviewers aligned and reduce subjective drift
* Audit labelled datasets and vendor output; track accuracy, agreement rates, and rework
* Define and report the metrics that matter: quality scores, TAT, cost per image, error patterns
* Translate recurring failure patterns into clear, prioritised feedback for ML and Product
* Partner with ML on dataset planning: what we need labelled, in what volume, by when
* Represent the photographer's perspective in product and model decisions


**🫂What You’ll Bring**
* 6\+ years of experience in photography, creative operations, or a related field, including time leading a team or managing vendors
* Professional photography experience, or deep hands\-on expertise across photography workflows
* Strong command of culling and editing tools (Lightroom, Photo Mechanic, Capture One, etc.)
* Ability to critique image selections and articulate why something works or doesn't
* Comfort building process from scratch: guidelines, QA checks, review cadences
* A data\-friendly approach to quality \- you're comfortable with spreadsheets, dashboards, and tracking numbers over time
* Clear written communication, especially when giving structured feedback
* Experience with data labelling or annotation operations is a strong plus
* Comfort working from the Delhi office on a full time basis


**What happens after you apply?**
* Step 1: If your profile aligns with our vibe and requirements for the role, our people team will reach out to you for a brief phone call.
* Step 2: If everything aligns, your next chat will be with one of your future team members to better understand the role and your experience.
* Step 3: You will then be given a task \- this helps us evaluate your thought process and help you showcase your expertise.
* Step 4: If everything goes well, you will meet the leadership for a quick bar\-raiser round.
* Step 5: If you do manage to clear all rounds, this is the point we make an offer, shake hands, and welcome you to the team.


**You will work with:**
* Captain: Aakansha
* Team Members: Shubham, Sandeep, Keshav, Monu and the rest of the Aftershoot team.

title: Subject Matter Expert In Production Machine Operation – Sterile Formulations
company: Life Sciences Sector Skill Development Council
description:
**Company Description** 
 Life Sciences Sector Skill Development Council (LSSSDC) is a Sector Skill Council approved by the National Council of Vocational Education and Training (NCVET) and works under the Ministry of Skill Development \& Entrepreneurship (MSDE), Government of India. LSSSDC leads skill development initiatives across pharmaceutical (including AYUSH), biotechnology and biopharmaceuticals, medical devices and IVD, allied biotech, and research \& development services. As an apex body, it covers the full spectrum of life sciences, including APIs, drug formulations, veterinary drugs, cosmetics, excipients, vaccines, biosimilars, and related sectors. The Council is mandated to skill approximately 3\.5 million professionals across diverse life sciences job roles by 2047, helping bridge critical skill gaps in the industry. Its mission includes creating occupational maps, establishing national occupational standards, developing industry\-aligned vocational qualifications, and setting up robust assessment, certification, and centres of excellence to support a strong talent pipeline.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Subject Matter Expert in Production Machine Operation – Sterile Formulations will provide technical and operational expertise on sterile manufacturing processes and equipment used in life sciences production environments. This on\-site role, based in Delhi, India, involves reviewing and developing occupational standards, training content, and assessment tools related to sterile formulations and production machine operations. The expert will collaborate with industry partners, training institutions, and internal teams to validate competency requirements, align curricula with regulatory and industry best practices, and support implementation of skilling programs. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include conducting technical reviews, participating in workshops and consultations, providing guidance on equipment handling and process workflows, and contributing to quality assurance for training and certification initiatives. The role may also involve supporting audits of training providers, mentoring trainers and assessors, and providing inputs to labour market intelligence and apprenticeship engagement related to sterile formulations.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong technical knowledge and hands\-on experience in sterile formulation manufacturing, including production machine operation, cleanroom practices, aseptic techniques, and GMP compliance.
* Experience with life sciences industry standards and regulatory frameworks relevant to pharmaceutical production (e.g., cGMP, WHO, national regulatory guidelines), and familiarity with validation, documentation, and quality systems.
* Background in developing or delivering training, including curriculum design, competency mapping, and assessment methodologies for technical or vocational education in the life sciences sector.
* Ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders such as industry experts, academic institutions, training partners, and regulatory bodies, with strong communication and presentation skills.
* Analytical skills to interpret industry trends, process data, and labour market information, and translate findings into practical recommendations for standards, qualifications, and skilling initiatives.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Pharmacy,

title: Production & QA Assistant
description:
**We invite you to come grow with us.**
 Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, bringing together connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion and precision, we connect insight, strategy and execution to help clients make stronger decisions, accelerate performance and deliver lasting impact for patients. Data, technology and AI enhance this work, alongside the human expertise and judgement that define our advisory offer.
   

  

**About The India Design Studio**
 We are establishing an India Design Studio in Gurugram to support Inizio Ignite's global teams. The studio will operate as a central design hub, working with business\-unit spokes across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and Innovation \& Growth.
   

  

 The Design Studio will turn complex strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear, persuasive client stories. It will support high\-value business development and client\-facing work, including proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority materials.
   

  

 Our goal is to improve the quality, speed and consistency of these materials; strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise; and build reusable design assets and ways of working that support client delivery and growth.
   

  

**How Quality Works In The Studio**
 Quality is shared. Everyone who creates or edits work is accountable for the accuracy and quality of their contribution. Designers complete a structured self\-check before handover. The Production \& QA Assistant provides independent, checklist\-based review and delivery control. The Senior Designer provides creative oversight and final design sign\-off for priority or high\-risk work. Business stakeholders remain accountable for factual content, client requirements and final business approval.
   

  

**How We Use AI**
 Approved AI and automation tools may be used to support brief understanding, content structuring, asset discovery, layout exploration, tagging and quality checks. They are enabling tools rather than substitutes for design craft. Human judgement, confidentiality, accessibility, brand integrity and final accountability always come first.
   

  

**Your Primary Role**
**Role: Production \& QA Assistant \- India Design Studio**
 Team: India Design Studio
   

  

 The Production \& QA Assistant is a foundational role in the Design Studio, combining junior production support, independent checklist\-based QA and workflow administration. You will help protect design time, strengthen delivery discipline and ensure that files are accurate, organised and ready for client or business use.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Apply approved templates and complete basic formatting or production updates to slides, documents and supporting materials.
* Perform independent QA after the designer has completed their self\-check, reviewing formatting, alignment, pagination, footnotes, spelling, grammar, consistency, brand application, accessibility and template compliance.
* Record QA findings clearly and return issues to the designer or Senior Designer for correction; the role supports quality control but does not replace designer or business\-owner accountability.
* Check briefs and source files for completeness and flag gaps before work begins.
* Log requests, update workflow trackers and maintain an accurate record of status, turnaround, rework, feedback and common quality issues.
* Manage file naming, folder structure, version control, handover notes and final delivery packages.
* Prepare editable source files, PDFs, linked assets and usage notes for final delivery where required.
* Tag reusable assets and maintain library metadata so approved content can be found, adapted and reused.
* Use approved AI\-enabled tools responsibly to support grammar, consistency, brief summarisation, tagging or QA, with careful human review before findings are acted on.
* Escalate missing information, conflicting versions, confidentiality concerns, delivery blockers or high\-risk quality issues to the Senior Designer or relevant workflow lead.


**About You**
**Your skills and experience**
* At least 1 year of experience in production support, presentation support, document QA, creative operations, project administration or another detail\-focused role; strong entry\-level candidates with relevant internships or portfolios may also be considered.
* Strong working knowledge of PowerPoint, Word, Excel, PDF workflows and Microsoft Teams/SharePoint or similar collaboration environments.
* Excellent attention to detail and confidence checking layout, formatting, spelling, grammar, page flow, naming conventions and version control.
* Basic understanding of brand guidelines, templates, accessibility and what makes a file ready for client\-facing use.
* Experience using trackers, logs, checklists, file structures or workflow documentation accurately and consistently.
* Clear communication skills and the confidence to flag gaps, errors or risks without taking ownership away from the person responsible for correcting them.
* Practical AI literacy and a responsible approach to confidential information and human review.
* Interest in presentation production, design craft, workflow improvement and healthcare or life\-sciences client work.


 Ideal profile
   

  

* You are highly accurate, organised and calm under time pressure.
* You enjoy making files cleaner, clearer and easier for others to use.
* You take pride in catching issues and communicating them constructively before materials are delivered.
* You are motivated to develop your production, quality or design skills as the studio grows.


**Career progression**
 This role is the foundation of the Design Studio career framework. With demonstrated design craft and a suitable portfolio, progression may lead to Designer and Senior Designer. Colleagues who build deeper expertise in workflow, quality, asset management and reporting may also develop toward a Studio Operations or QA specialist pathway. Progression is based on capability, impact and available business opportunities.
   

  

**Life at Inizio Ignite**
 You will join a connected, global business where collaboration, curiosity, drive and agility shape how we work. We encourage people to bring their authentic selves, keep learning, challenge the status quo and do the right thing.
   

  

 In the Design Studio, you will have the opportunity to help build a new capability, work with international teams and influence how Ignite presents its expertise to clients.
   

  

**We provide**
* A learning culture with opportunities to develop design, technology, AI and healthcare knowledge.
* International collaboration across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and wider Inizio teams.
* A supportive, inclusive and friendly working environment where your contribution matters.
* A visible career framework, supported by regular feedback, skills development and opportunities to take on greater complexity and responsibility.


**Further information**
 This is a full\-time role and is expected to follow a hybrid working pattern, based at our Inizio location in Gurugram. The role will support global teams across time zones, so flexibility to work within agreed UK\- and US\-aligned collaboration windows may be required. The exact reporting line, working pattern and hours will be confirmed during the recruitment process.
   

  

*Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.*

title: P&C Analyst (FTC)
description:
**Department:** 
 Core \- People \& Culture
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram, India
   

  




**Description**
 Aurora Energy Research is replacing IrisHR with SAP SuccessFactors, with go\-live planned for Q1 2027\. This is a fixed\-term role dedicated to testing the new platform across our global entities as part of our second iteration test phase.
   

 You will be the person who finds the problems before our employees do. Every process that P\&C runs has to work correctly in the new system on day one, in all countries with different rules. Your job is to prove that it does, and to be precise about what doesn't.
   

  

 This role is offered as a
 **fixed\-term contract (2 Months)** 
 tied to the Testing phase of implementation. It will not extend beyond the project.
   

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Test execution** 
* Execute system integration testing, regression testing and end\-to\-end process testing across all countries
* Validate country\-specific configuration \- local employment terms, statutory fields, leave rules, approval hierarchies and reporting requirements


**Defect management** 
* Log, reproduce and prioritise defects with enough detail that the implementation partner can act without a follow\-up conversation
* Track defects to closure, retest fixes, and maintain a clear view of what is open, what is resolved and what is a known limitation


**Data and cutover support** 
* Support cutover rehearsal and post\-migration verification


**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
**Essential** 
* Genuine attention to detail, and the discipline to follow a script fully rather than stopping at the first thing that works
* Clear written communication \- a defect report that someone else can act on without asking you what you meant
* Ability to work independently and manage your own testing queue against a fixed deadline


**Desirable** 
* Direct experience with SAP SuccessFactors, particularly Time Off
* Experience with test management or defect tracking tools
* Exposure to a full implementation lifecycle from design
